output.reasoning:
Anchors: Dinner (temple nine) fixes Félix's watch at -20 (Odile independently confirms it showed 8:40). Casimir's watch was +2. Piano start at 22:43 true is fixed by Casimir (piquet ended 10:45 by his watch, +2 = 10:43, and Odile began playing as he left), and matches Rosa's kitchen clock (+15) and Lina's reading of the same clock. That gives Girard's watch -14.

Félix's repeater timestamps convert to 22:35 (someone quickly up past the library), 22:38 (thump and repeater, with ten hours, two doubled notes and eight highs, matching "some doubled notes" and quick highs), and 22:41 (someone quickly down). Girard's offset is -14, so his "quick bells" at 22:34 by his watch is really 22:48, and his "came back at 22:46 by my watch" is really 23:00. Félix says Girard entered the library at 22:32 by his watch, which is 22:52 true.

Only two sources disagree on the blow: Félix (22:38, with a consistent dinner-anchored watch corroborated by Odile) and Girard (22:48). Girard is the one with a motive (he wanted the repeater and was refused) and the only one whose account puts him somewhere nobody can check at the moment of the blow. He says he went out at 22:35, exactly when Félix heard someone go up. His cigar lit at 22:43, which is exactly when a man coming down from the atelier at 22:41 could reach the street, given the five-minute rule. His bells at 22:48 and his 23:00 return both sit 8–10 minutes after the true events, which is the pattern of a murderer moving the blow to a moment he can claim he was outside. Félix's account is internally consistent with the dinner anchor, so I take Girard as the liar.

Other suspects: Odile and Casimir are mutually corroborated in the salon until 22:43, and Rosa heard the piano continuously from 22:43 to 22:56. Lina is in the kitchen from about 22:32 by Rosa's account. The stopped regulator at 10:05 is most likely a false time set by the murderer's hand, which Girard could manage during his 22:35–22:41 visit upstairs.

Residual inconsistency: Lina's claimed 10:20 departure and Rosa's 10:32 kitchen arrival are 12 minutes apart, which breaks the five-minute rule. I could not resolve this without a second liar, so it lowers my confidence.
